findings.title: Retired-path matching logic is split and the list is dead production data
findings.problem: RETIRED_PATHS is exported and tested, but neither middleware.js nor isRetired() consumes it. The actual retired set is hardcoded twice: the Vercel matcher hardcodes /compare, and isRetired() hardcodes the /compare prefix. If a future retired path outside /compare is added to RETIRED_PATHS, isRetired() would return true for it but middleware would not answer 410.
findings.failure_scenario: Developer adds '/old-course/' to RETIRED_PATHS and assumes publication is retired; traffic to /old-course/ falls through to the normal 404/static path instead of the 410 middleware.
findings.fix: Have middleware or isRetired derive behavior from RETIRED_PATHS, or rename the list so it cannot be mistaken for the actual retired-path source.

findings.title: Public 410 can be cached for an hour after same-URL relaunch
findings.problem: The 410 response is cacheable with public, max-age=3600. The file comment explicitly contemplates relaunching a page at the same URL later. A cached 410 could still be served by browsers/proxies for up to an hour after that relaunch.
findings.failure_scenario: Page /compare/pulsern-vs-uworld/ is relaunched; a visitor who previously received the 410 within the current hour may still see Gone instead of the new page.
findings.fix: Use a shorter TTL for the 410, add a purge mechanism on relaunch, or document that the cache TTL must be cleared as part of relaunch.

findings.title: 404 page has two sources of truth and no drift test
findings.problem: The 404 markup exists both as a committed public/404.html and as notFoundPage() in build-public-pages.mjs. The tests read the committed file, not builder output, so the generated page can drift from the tested artifact without failing CI.
findings.failure_scenario: ATTRIBUTION_BOOT_TAG, CSS, or footer/legal copy changes in the builder; build rewrites public/404.html, but tests continue validating the old strings or no longer catch a regression in the deployed file.
findings.fix: Either generate the public file only and delete the duplicate source, or add a test that executes notFoundPage() and compares it to public/404.html.

assessment: No blockers or majors found in clinical content, scoring, data handling, or security. Three minor maintainability concerns below.
